speaker: unfinished_borrower
text: Mind the step. It was always loose.

speaker: unfinished_borrower
text: I left the bread on the sill. Someone should take it in.

speaker: unfinished_borrower
text: Tell her I will be home before dark.

speaker: unfinished_borrower
text: That is my coat. I know that coat.

speaker: warden_guide
text: You carry the storm and swing it like a stick. Hold it so, and throw. There. It goes where you look.
